# maple_api_key (Resource)

A Maple API key. The secret is only returned when the key is created or rolled, and is stored in state: treat the state as sensitive. Destroying the resource revokes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "time_rotating" "quarterly" {
  rotation_days = 90
}

resource "maple_api_key" "grafana" {
  name   = "grafana-readonly"
  scopes = ["dashboards:read", "traces:read", "metrics:read"]
  # Changing this rolls the key: the old key is revoked and a new one issued.
  rotate = time_rotating.quarterly.id
}

output "grafana_key" {
  value     = maple_api_key.grafana.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Key name. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Changing it replaces the key.
- `expires_in_seconds` (Number) Lifetime from creation. Unset means the key does not expire. Changing it replaces the key.
- `kind` (String) `standard` (default) or `mcp`. Changing it replaces the key.
- `rotate` (String) Any value; changing it rolls the key: Maple revokes it and issues a replacement with the same name, description, kind and scopes, a new ID and a new secret. For example the `id` of a `time_rotating` resource.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes like `dashboards:read` or `alerts:write`. Unset means full access. Changing them replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When the key expires, if it does.
- `id` (String) The `key_…` public ID. Rolling the key (changing `rotate`) issues a new ID.
- `key_prefix` (String) The visible start of the secret, as shown in Maple.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The `maple_ak_…` secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_api_key.example <id>
```
